title: Bar Crawl (miniquest)
start: Talk to one of the barbarian guards at the outer entrance of the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.

items.t: 208 coins to buy all the required liquor

recommended.t: Food to recover from beer that inflicts damage.
Unlocked Lodestone Network or teleportation runes
Restore potions to restore skills that are lowered

rewards.t: Access to the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.

steps.t: Talk to barbarian guard located east of Barbarian assault. [Chat: 1 I want to come through this gate. › 2 Looks can be deceiving, I am in fact a barbarian. › Accept]
Bars are marked with on the world map. It may be helpful to turn off other map icons so that it is easier to locate the bars during the miniquest.

Go to the floor 2 of the Grand Tree and talk to Blurberry. [Chat: Any] You can use Home Teleport to Al Kharid and then take the Gnome Glider to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, Ardougne lodestone and run north-west, or Eagles' Peak lodestone with 61 Agility and head east.
Home Teleport to plink | Seers' Village | pic=Seers' Village lodestone icon | size=18 , and then visit the Forester's Arms. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 3 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]

Home Teleport to plink | Ardougne | pic=Ardougne lodestone icon | size=18 , then proceed to the Flying Horse Inn, located directly north of Ardougne castle. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 3 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]
Home Teleport to plink | Yanille | pic=Yanille lodestone icon | size=18 , and then visit the Dragon Inn. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 4 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]

Home Teleport to plink | Karamja | pic=Karamja lodestone icon | size=18 . Run north and then east until you reach the Dead Man's Chest. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 4 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]
Home Teleport to plink | Port Sarim | pic=Port Sarim lodestone icon | size=18 . Run north-east to the Rusty Anchor. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 1 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]

sub.t: If you do not have Visions of Havenhythe started then [Chat: 2 Talk about something else. › 1 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]

steps.t: Run south and 'Travel Karamja' on Captain Tobias just east of the lodestone. Run west to the pub and talk to Zembo. [Chat: 3 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]
Home Teleport to plink | Varrock | pic=Varrock lodestone icon | size=18 and run north to the Blue Moon Inn. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 4 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]
Home Teleport to plink | Fort Forinthry | pic=Fort Forinthry lodestone icon | size=18 and head south-west to the Jolly Boar Inn. Talk to the Bartender. [Chat: 4 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]
Home Teleport to plink | Falador | pic=Falador lodestone icon | size=18 and go to the Rising Sun Inn. Talk to Emily or Kaylee. [Chat: 2 I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.]
Return to the Barbarian Outpost, ideally by using a games necklace, and talk to the Barbarian guard.
